title: Phenakistoscope
description: Early optical toy associated with the perception of sequential moving images.

title: Pauvre Pierrot
description: Émile Reynaud presents a 500-frame animated work in Paris.

title: Humorous Phases of Funny Faces
description: J. Stuart Blackton uses chalk animation in a landmark early cartoon.

title: Fantasmagorie
description: Émile Cohl makes a landmark hand-drawn animation on paper/film.

title: El Apóstol
description: BFI timeline records the first animated feature as a 70-minute Argentine cut-out satire, now lost.

title: The Adventures of Prince Achmed
description: Lotte Reiniger creates a feature-length silhouette animation.

title: Steamboat Willie
description: Disney releases a synchronized sound cartoon featuring Mickey Mouse.

title: Flowers and Trees
description: Disney releases a three-colour Technicolor cartoon.

title: Genesis Effect sequence
description: Pixar history records a completely computer-animated feature-film sequence from Star Trek II.

title: Pixar established
description: The Lucasfilm Computer Division is purchased and established as Pixar; Pixar and Disney collaborate on CAPS.

title: Tin Toy
description: Pixar’s Tin Toy becomes the first computer animated film to receive an Academy Award.

title: Toy Story
description: Released as the first computer-animated feature film, according to Pixar and the Academy.

title: Toy Story 2
description: Pixar states that Toy Story 2 was the first film entirely created, mastered and exhibited digitally.
